title: 第1642章 胜局已定第1641章 收服巫祖强者
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“等等！”
就在帝塔即将把血色铭文，朝着祝青锋头顶按去时，祝青锋直接闪身避开。
“怎么？想要反悔？祝首领，你可要想好反悔的代价！”
帝塔眉头皱起，手中血色铭文并未收起，语气里，也带上了威胁的意味。
“我不接受你的奴役！”
祝青锋冷冷的拒绝了帝塔，抓头看向苏星河，阴沉着脸道：
“我们事先商量好的是，成为你的奴仆，却没说过要成为帝塔的奴仆！请动手吧！”
说完，祝青锋像是认命了一般低下头，再不言语。
“你......”
不等苏星河开口，帝塔对着三人怒目而视，只不过，祝青锋说的并没有错，他也无从反驳！
“的的尸傀炼魂之法，与你们巫族奴印不同，对神魂有极高的要求，我所能分出的单独神魂有限，不能再次对你施展了！”
苏星河摇头道。
“什么？不能施展？”
祝青锋眉头紧皱，他是无论如何都没想到，自己主动要成为他的奴仆，却反过来被告知，没有名额了，他差点没当场吐出血来。
与祝青锋的憋屈不同，帝塔却是大喜，既然苏星河无法再次分出神魂，去炼化祝青锋，最后机会，还是要落在他的身上。
只是，没等他开口，就见苏星河转过头，对身旁的封极道：
“封极道友，这《九幽炼魂录》和《尸傀炼魂录》，你可有修炼？”
“当然，壮大神魂的术法，如此难得，老夫既然得到，又怎会暴殄天物？不但修炼了，而且，还勉强达到了小成！”
封劫轻捋胡须，神色得意，先前，在听到苏星河说，要让帝塔去控制其余三人时，他就想开口阻拦，只不过，被苏星河直接打断了。
眼下，见这个机会，最终还是落在自己身上，顿时大喜。

要知道，能够将一位元婴境的巫族强者，炼化为自己的尸傀，并且，这个巫族强者，在秘法加持下，还能施展出堪比化神境的强大术法，百年不遇，他自然不会放过。
“祝首领，那就再给你个选择的机会，在帝塔首领和封极道友中，选一人！”
苏星河收起脸上笑意，语气严肃。
“这......”
祝青锋犹豫了一下，还想反驳，但看到苏星河脸上，已经没了先前的揶揄，眼中似有杀意涌现，不敢再废话，连忙道:
“我愿意成为他的奴仆，但有一个条件！”
“你是想让封极道友，也发下相同的天道誓言？”
苏星河看穿了他的想法，直接问道。
“正是！只要他发下天道誓言，我便遵守约定！”
“好！老夫依你！”
不等苏星河开口劝导，封极也伸出三指，学着苏星河先前的誓言，一字不差的重复了一遍。
在他发下天道誓言的瞬间，晴朗的苍穹之上，突兀的闪过一道天雷，虽然微弱，在场的众人，却都看得仔细。
“引起了天道回响？”
content_en:
"Wait!"
Just when the Imperial Tower was about to press the bloody inscription towards Zhu Qingfeng's head, Zhu Qingfeng dodged to avoid it.
"What? You want to go back on your word? Chief, you have to think about the price of going back on your word!"
Di Ta frowned, but did not put away the bloody inscription in his hand, and his tone also contained a hint of threat.
"I will not accept your servitude!"
Zhu Qingfeng coldly rejected Di Ta, scratched his head, looked at Su Xinghe, and said gloomily:
"We agreed in advance that we would become your slaves, but we never said we would become the slaves of the Imperial Tower! Please do it!"
After saying that, Zhu Qingfeng lowered his head as if he had resigned himself to his fate and remained silent.
"You..."
Before Su Xinghe could speak, Di Ta glared at the three of them. However, what Zhu Qingfeng said was not wrong, and he had no way to refute it!
"The Corpse Puppet Soul Refining Method is different from the slave seal of your Witch Clan. It has extremely high requirements for the soul. The individual souls I can separate are limited, so I can't use it on you again!"
Su Xinghe shook his head.
"What? Can't cast it?"
Zhu Qingfeng frowned. He never expected that he would take the initiative to become his slave, only to be told that there were no more places. He almost vomited blood on the spot.
Different from Zhu Qingfeng's frustration, Di Ta was overjoyed. Since Su Xinghe could not separate his soul again to refine Zhu Qingfeng, the last chance would still fall on him.
However, before he could speak, Su Xinghe turned his head and said to Feng Ji beside him:
"Fellow Taoist Fengji, have you practiced the "Nine Nether Soul Refining Record" and "Zombie Soul Refining Record"?
"Of course, the technique of strengthening the soul is so rare. Now that I have obtained it, how can I waste it? Not only have I practiced it, but I have also barely achieved a small success!"
Feng Jie stroked his beard lightly and looked proud. Previously, when he heard Su Xinghe said that he wanted Di Pa to control the other three people, he wanted to stop him, but was interrupted by Su Xinghe.
Now, seeing that this opportunity finally fell to me, I was overjoyed.
You must know that he can refine a strong witch from the Nascent Soul Realm into his own corpse. Moreover, with the blessing of secret techniques, this strong witch can also perform powerful spells that are comparable to those at the God Transformation Realm. He has never seen them in a hundred years, so he will naturally not let him go.
"I wish you the best, Chief, then I will give you another chance to choose. Choose one of the leaders of the Imperial Tower and Fellow Daoist Fengji!"
Su Xinghe put away the smile on his face and spoke in a serious tone.
"This..."
Zhu Qingfeng hesitated for a moment and wanted to refute, but when he saw that Su Xinghe's face had lost the previous teasing, and there seemed to be killing intent in his eyes, he did not dare to talk nonsense anymore, and said quickly:
"I am willing to be his slave, but there is one condition!"
"Do you want fellow Taoist Fengji to take the same oath of heaven?"
Su Xinghe saw through his thoughts and asked directly.
"Exactly! As long as he swears the oath of heaven, I will abide by the agreement!"
"Okay! I'm following you!"
Without waiting for Su Xinghe to start persuading him, Feng Ji also stretched out three fingers, imitating Su Xinghe's previous oath, and repeated it word for word.
The moment he made the oath of heaven, a thunderbolt suddenly flashed across the clear sky. Although it was weak, everyone present saw it carefully.
"Has it caused a resounding response from heaven?"
